prose: Dr. Gregory L. Little joins InnerVerse to discuss his book, Origins of the Gods, co-written with Andrew Collins. A paranormal, psychological, & archeological adventurer, Dr. Little discusses mound culture, the Moth-Man, shamanic manifestation of spiritual beings, Cygnus & the journey of departed souls, the guardian of the threshold, and cosmology of two souls.
ext: We talk about electromagnetic memory, Native American creation stories and the trinity, the biology of plasma beings & light orbs, entity contact stories of Edgar Cayce, Joan of Arc & Swedenborg, psychedelics and synesthesia.
music: InnerVerse intro theme by Conspiracy Music Guru
